title: cararta garbok tan xongolo
intro: safar kaak assakat le angaarawak qimbiseeh, kaak maadi addah obte ummattah amobaxxaaqa luk angaaraw luk sugeh yan kaxxa numih kinnaane qaddos. ta num doorimeh monumental taamah, foocal kaxxa gexkalit yallih qokol luk.
clues: Anu elle oobokem kaxxa zulmih udduruy, yi ummattak alaaqa edde qideenih sugeenim.
yok dumaahi mano yi xaleenak daqaaral daffeyte, uxih anu geytimeh sugem kee yi ummattah zulmih buxah addal yenbe.
Anu inki adda magaalak kudeh sugeek lakal cankah raba kataaseek lakal tuhat uddur.
Anu qibaadah farmo hirgeeh, assakat le taama abeynit diini aracal, caylale miraacah foocal akah gexannah amriseenih sugeenim.
yi toobokoyti yoo cateyna akkuk muggaaqime yi farmol, yi yaabih addat tan adafittek amakkaquk.
Anu inni ummatta miraacisak baxsime badak amot, qanxaffe le qandeh gexsitak kudak.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
